title: Golos: Russian Dataset for Speech Research
manual_evidence: Recordings are manually annotated on a crowdsourcing platform; Sber states each recording was annotated by multiple people.
lineage_notes: Crowd and far-field partitions are one Golos release family; do not count Opus/WAV mirrors as distinct recordings.
notes: Core eligibility is for human-verified utterance annotation/transcription. No claim is made that word/phone boundaries are manual. OpenSLR reports train 1,103,799 + test 11,910 utterances; 1,227.4 + 12.6 h.
